name: Browser
description: Surf the web in a desk window: a live page under an address field, with back, forward, reload and stop. The page is its own browser, apart from the desk: it reads nothing of the desk and keeps its cookies to itself.

commands.title: Browser: Go to an address
commands.description: Show a web page in the Browser: an address (example.com, https://example.com/a) or words to search for.

endue.browser.home.description: The page a new Browser window opens on; empty opens no page.

endue.browser.search.description: Where words typed into the address field are searched for: %s is replaced by the words.
